card.name: Concession verbs before a that-clause
card.fires_on: Verbs of conceding or agreeing (concedes, agreed, recognizes, acknowledged) right after a named person, in general web prose. The next words usually begin a 'that' clause giving a qualifying point.

modes.label: Agreement verbs
modes.description: A person or group is said to agree, even partly, with a view, followed by 'that'.

modes.label: Concession or recognition verbs
modes.description: Verbs like concedes, recognizes or acknowledged introduce a grudging admission.
modes.example: Weiner con<<cedes>> that proponents from all these groups actually committed

modes.label: Concession comma
modes.description: A comma after a phrase like 'It must be admitted, however' that leads into the admitted point.
